text:
lina_sales: Hey team — Cygnus (prospect) just uploaded a completed SIG/CAIQ and a follow-up questionnaire. They need our answers for procurement by EOW. Can security own the review + provide any gaps we should surface to the AE? Attachment: https://files.redwood/cygnus-sig-2026.pdf

kevin_sec: I can take primary review. Quick Q: do we have any recent SOC2 / penetration test artifacts for the Hosted API to reference? AE wants a one-pager of controls + evidence links.

sam_se: I can draft the controls map (mapping SIG sections -> Redwood controls) and a template response set. Ping me with the contract timeline so I can prioritize.

lina_sales: Target deadline is Thu COB. Procurement is asking about encryption in transit & at rest, data retention for PII, and data isolation for Dedicated offering. They might also ask for on-prem options later.

kevin_sec: For encryption: we have TLS 1.2+ for in-transit and AES-256 for at-rest. I'll pull exact KMS flow and HSM integration notes.

alex_support: I will surface the Dedicated isolation docs and the VPC/private-deploy sheet. Also dropping link to SOC2 cert in the channel: https://internal.redwood/reports/soc2-2025.pdf :lock:

sam_se: To speed answers, here's a quick snippet I use to show S3 config for customer-controlled backups:
```
Backups: Encrypted at-rest (AES-256), SSE-KMS using customer KMS keys, access limited via IAM roles and VPC endpoints.
```

kevin_sec: Good. Two action items for me: 1) map SIG control gaps (if any) and list required evidence; 2) mark any high-risk items for legal review (e.g., cross-border data controls). I'll aim to post draft answers by tomorrow afternoon.

lina_sales: Awesome. Please escalate anything that blocks the sales cadence — AE is open to a call with security if needed. Contact: marc@cygnus.com (procurement lead).

vendorbot: Assignment created -> ticket VR-4192, owner: kevin_sec, due: 1765199999. :white_check_mark:

kevin_sec: Noted. I'll attach the control mapping and a short summary of outstanding evidence to VR-4192 when ready.

sam_se: If you want, I can pre-fill the questionnaire fields for the common items so legal only needs to sign off. Saves time.

lina_sales: Please do that, sam. Also, can someone flag if any question requires a configuration change rather than just documentation? Procurement asks for tangible steps.

kevin_sec: Will flag config changes. Early candidate: retention for request logs — currently default 90d, policy change would need infra coordination.

alex_support: FYI — I scheduled a short sync with AE + Cygnus for Thu 10:30 PT to walk the answers if we have them ready. Calendar invite sent.

lina_sales: Great. Thanks everyone. 

kevin_sec: I'll share the first draft in VR-4192 and drop a copy here when done. :eyes:

sam_se: +1, will start populating common fields now.

lina_sales: (closing note) If anything slips, we'll request a 48-hour extension from Cygnus rather than rush incomplete answers.
